hypotheses.reasoning: account-svc v4.30.0 (build dba9b15) was rolled out at 01:10:50 (#2813), replacing v4.29.6. Logins succeeded right up to the rollout. From about 01:12:43 onward, account-svc throws TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading region)' at user-formatter.ts:209 for POST /login requests (#3171, #3371, #3442, #3642), all tagged [v4.30.0]. Edge-proxy converts these into POST /login 500s with 5-29s latency (e.g. #3135, #3254, #4331), which is the 15% 500 rate on the alert. The onset matches the deploy and the error is code-level (a missing user.region field in the new formatter), so the fault is the release itself. Other errors in the window are downstream or unrelated: order-service ECONNREFUSED to payment-svc (#3079, #3156, #3401) drives /checkout 503s but not /login; billing-reconciler invoice_archive checksum errors and flag-sync 'unknown flag in staging-2' warnings are separate noise that does not touch the login path.

Alternative for the broader incident: payment-svc at 10.8.195.56:8081 refuses connections from order-service, which causes /checkout 503s. This does not explain the POST /login 500s, which come from account-svc. Ruled out as the cause of the login alert.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back account-svc from v4.30.0 to v4.29.6 now to restore /login. Then fix user-formatter.ts:209 so it handles users with a missing region, or confirm the data shape the new code expects, before redeploying. Separately, investigate payment-svc refusing connections on 10.8.195.56:8081 (causing /checkout 503s) and the invoice_archive checksum failures in billing-reconciler, which are outside this login incident.
